scope: Optional AC1012/AC1014 adapter evidence, not output qualification
implementation: Bound a maximum of 65536 reader-published physical object-map frames to one successful import generation and attempt; require a complete publication-only frame report, unique handles, offsets and ordinals, and one unchanged published CLASS entry for a requested class number. Reject incomplete or stale evidence without changing import success or result on failure.
controls: Unit controls cover zero and nonzero counts, generation and attempt mismatch, duplicate handle/offset/ordinal, missing location, wrong version, incomplete or inconsistent report, unknown or failed dispositions, invalid type/handle, failed read, post-seal callback, bounded capacity, AC1014 synthetic control, and corrected retry.

The two locally authored rooted AC1012 resaves were imported through the actual adapter. Each reports 0 GEODATA, 2 LAYOUT and 1 ACDBDICTIONARYWDFLT frame; changing the import generation rejects the query and restoring it permits retry.

A separate bounded physical CLASS and object-map walker reports the same counts and 44 mapped frames in each sample. A scratch instrumented reader comparison matched the 44 published handle, type and offset tuples in the destination to that physical census.
limits: Generated sample binaries are local scratch artifacts and are not committed.
The independent physical walker covers only the selected bounded AC1012 files; AC1014 is currently a synthetic adapter control.

A complete reader publication census is not independent semantic proof or permission to omit a CLASS or relax output guards. Native cloning, target CLASS behavior, graph closure and staged output remain open.
